entries.causal_hypothesis: A portable local technical Entry state should separate trades that never become profitable from trades that establish any favorable excursion.
entries.decision: Close local technical Entry separator research. Do not create an RSI/MACD/EMA/Bollinger/volatility/OHLC threshold family.
falsified_or_unsupported_claims: A stable RSI threshold identifies P3 across folds
local momentum or volatility combination provides portable P3 admission
same accepted full-OHLC indicator family can be constructed across all folds
entries.origin_analysis: Independent reconstruction from exact 2023, 2024H1 and 2024H2 repository artifacts evaluated technical Entry information for baseline B02/F05 P3 trades.
pre_result_predictions: P3 counts and technical statistics reproduce the source analysis
at least one factor has same-sign |delta| >= 0.10 in all four folds if a portable separator exists
held-out multivariate performance is stable if combination information exists
prohibited_reuse: no side year or session exception
retained_findings: F05 P3 shows weak overextension tendency but not portable separation
post-entry trajectory contains materially stronger information
Entry features are no-lookahead and the negative result is interpretable
successor_questions: Does a profit-armed event-defined post-entry state collapse reduce P2/P1 losses without cutting the winner right tail?
target_failure_mode: local overextension or momentum exhaustion before Entry

tests.type: exact release-authority technical reproduction and Entry information audit

entries.causal_hypothesis: After executable profit is first established, a synchronized transition of side-aligned four-bar momentum, MACD histogram and price-to-EMA20 distance to nonpositive states identifies directional-state collapse. P2 and P1 use separate arming events and are never combined after outcomes.
entries.decision: Evaluate exactly eight frozen cells once on the four development folds after this package merges. Close if no within-arm connected eligible region exists; otherwise freeze at most one representative before MT4 parity.
entries.origin_analysis: The Entry audit closed with zero portable local separators. P2 and P1 landmark analyses independently reproduced materially stronger post-entry separation, while Families C/D/E/G/H showed that fixed P/L checkpoints, breakout reacceptance and exposure routing sacrifice winners or fail breadth.
pre_result_predictions: within at least one arm two adjacent cells pass every fold core gate
at least one cell in that arm passes full breadth and date-removal gates
target-class benefit is positive in every fold
top-decile winner profit retention remains at least 90%
B02 F05 long and short deltas are nonnegative in every fold
prohibited_reuse: no side year session or strategy exception
no grid expansion or gate change after outcomes
no MT4 or 2025 before exact finalist and parity
retained_findings: P1 must not exit at the +10 arming event
profit arming is observation start only and not the Exit trigger
state thresholds are natural zero-state definitions rather than fitted indicator levels
successor_questions: Does either the P2 or P1 arm form a robust within-arm family region across all four folds?
